instruction.text: In 2021, the government spent its money on the following things. Put the values in order, starting with the most.

atoms.b: The government spent nearly three times as much on health as it did on ((++education justice)).
The government spent around £180,000,000 less on justice than it did on ((education ++health)).

instruction.text: The government also spent money on the following things. Put these values in order, starting with the least.

atoms.b: The government spent around £3,000,000 more on industry than it did on ((++defence transport)).
The government spent the least amount of money on ((++transport defence industry)).
The government spent around £12,000,000 more on ((++industry defence)) than on transport.
